summary.text: Paul Santucci is a Republican state representative from District 53 who took office on January 7, 2025 and is seeking re-election; he advanced from the Republican primary on September 9, 2026.
Ballotpedia lists his profession as financial advisor.

paragraphs.text: Santucci's career experience includes working as a financial advisor, according to Ballotpedia.

He has served as president of the Smithfield Town Council and on the Water Advisory Commission of the Smithfield Water Supply Board, and he has been a member of the Smithfield Community Emergency Response Team and worked on the town's 2020 Charter Review Commission.
